headline: New TPP in Kara-Kech will have no harmful emissions — Deputy Minister of Energy
summary: A deputy energy minister said the planned thermal power plant in Kara-Kech will reduce Kyrgyzstan's dependence on electricity imports. Modern filters will be used to limit emissions.
why: New domestic generation capacity reduces reliance on electricity imports and affects energy security and public spending on power infrastructure. Thermal plants are a major source of power in many developing economies.
original_headline: На новой ТЭС в Кара-Кече не будет вредных выбросов — замминистра энергетики
